assertion_review.check_contract.py:17: Fails when the post-sixth-update fresh evaluation is removed: the extracted actual loop never sees the root attained on update six; inherited helper substitutes its own acceptance predicate.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:18: Fails when either arm removes enough accepted_read call sites; this is an AST call-count check, not a behavioral acceptance-predicate test.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:22: Fails when the vertical flux gradient is not 2*pi*R for a unit Bz; does not assert flux value or radial Hessian.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:23: Fails on nonzero height derivative or mixed/height Hessian for uniform Bz.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:71: Fails if the valid read or the assembled live row/column presence reports false in the connected synthetic update.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:72: Fails when the synthetic constrained update does not restore physical radius 2 m; the target is a specified invariant checked on the changed state, not an automatic input echo.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:73: Fails if the centroid omits centre*current: independently known physical radius is 2.1 m, observed in local-moment-negative.log EXIT=1.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:74: Fails if the bordered source correction has the wrong sign or unit scaling in this synthetic problem (expected 0.1 T).
assertion_review.check_contract.py:75: Fails if the radial update leaks into the vertical moment; independent expected unchanged value is 0.3.
assertion_review.check_contract.py:81: Fails if payload=False still reports an active assembled constraint; does not assert finite updates for an intentionally disconnected singular system.
assertion_review.compare.py:12-27: Refuses unequal arm reach/flags/counts, missing or unequal-length spectra, invalid reads and disagreeing drive/singular values; receipt-controls.log records actual count-mismatch and missing-spectrum refusals.
assertion_review.measure.py:299-304: Raises when a real assembled scratch row or field column is absent; recorded H200 PIN_ACTIVE=true derives from live g and field_column.
assertion_review.measure.py:404-405: Refuses invalid selected reads or nonfinite selected smallest singular values.
assertion_review.measure.py:412: Fails when configure_dtypes has not enabled x64.
assertion_review.measure.py:49-60: Refuses unexpected constraint row counts; zero is checked against state dimension but this added radial check_contract does not invoke the predecessor positive row-count probe.
assertion_review.tautological_assertions: No assertion found whose expected value merely echoes the value supplied to the code; identified limitations are zero current-direction coverage and an injected acceptance predicate, not input echo.
